summary.text: Dillon Travis represents House District 35 in the Oklahoma House of Representatives. He is a sixth-generation Oklahoman from Pawnee County with a background in agriculture and small business.

paragraphs.text: Travis owns and operates Southern Plains AG-CO, an agricultural company serving producers across four states, and manages his family's cattle and hay operation in Maramec.
He and his wife, Kaylee, are raising their daughter.

sources.title: Representative Dillon Travis (Oklahoma House of Representatives)
